integrity: The general theorem is proved analytically from cyclotomic Galois invariance, a sharp multiplicity lemma, and Fourier inversion. Finite enumeration is used only as an exact replay check in small cases.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for rational-valued functions on \(\mathbb F_p^2\), not arbitrary complex-valued functions.
Only the balanced equality slice \(|\operatorname{supp}f|=|\operatorname{supp}\widehat f|\) is classified.
A differently phrased or unindexed equivalent result remains a residual originality risk.
title: Balanced rational equality cases in the finite-plane uncertainty bound
